metadata.description: Reviewed GCMS-to-Beach-Box identity hints for construction-pattern reporting only. Raw GCMS material names remain preserved; related-family rows are not exact substitutions.
guardrails: Do not use this file to change formulas, IFRA logic, pricing, accord recipes, sensory data, UI, or AI/API behavior.
Do not collapse distinct formulation materials when only a related family relationship is known.
Do not add IFRA limits, GCMS values, or CAS numbers from this alias file.
